adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: On Morag in 2014, Nebula and Rhodes knock out a younger Quill and take the Power Stone before he can reach it. In the battle against Thanos, a past Gamora knocks Quill down and he turns to Nebula, confused.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A younger version of him is knocked out on Morag so Nebula can take the Power Stone.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Knocks out his younger self on Morag to take the Power Stone.
adds.evidence: 2014 Morag: Nebula and Rhodes wait for Quill, knock him out and collect the Power Stone; in the Battle of Earth Quill looks to Nebula in confusion after the 2014 Gamora rejects him.

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: Back after five years gone, Ned spots Peter at school and the two best friends share an emotional reunion.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Ned's best friend, reunited with him at school after the Blip.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Peter's best friend, who runs to him at school after the Blip.
adds.evidence: After the Blip, on the first day of the new school year, Ned sees Peter and they have an emotional reunion.

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: When Shuri returns from the Blip, Okoye is reunited with her and walks beside her and T'Challa through a sorcerer's portal to lead Wakanda's army against Thanos.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Returns from the Blip and marches into battle at Okoye's side.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Reunited with Shuri after the Blip, she leads Wakanda's army beside her.
adds.evidence: After the Blip, Okoye is reunited with T'Challa and Shuri; alongside them she walks through a portal and leads the Wakandan armies into the Battle of Earth.

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: When T'Challa returns from the Blip, Okoye is at his side again, and they walk through a sorcerer's portal together to lead Wakanda's army against Thanos.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Okoye's king, back from the Blip. She leads his army into battle beside him.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: T'Challa's general, back at his side to lead Wakanda's army against Thanos.
adds.evidence: After the Blip, Okoye is reunited with her king; with T'Challa and Shuri she walks through a portal and leads the Wakandan armies into the Battle of Earth.

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: Reunited after the Blip, Rocket and Quill mourn Tony with the Guardians. When Thor joins them on the Benatar and questions Quill's leadership, Rocket offers blasters to settle it.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Back with Quill after the Blip. Offers blasters when Thor questions his leadership.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Back with Rocket after the Blip, defending his place as the Guardians' leader.
adds.evidence: Rocket attends Tony's funeral with the reunited Guardians; on the Benatar, during Thor and Quill's squabble over leadership, Rocket says he has blasters they could use.

owner_calls.title: Avengers: Endgame
owner_calls.question: Fury and Hill appear in Endgame only at Tony's funeral, after he dies (they hear his recorded message with everyone else). Should attending someone's funeral count as a stage between them?
options: No stage: funeral attendance alone is not an exchange (current answer)
Add a stage for Fury and for Hill: they attend Tony's funeral
owner_calls.evidence: Hill is restored by the Blip and attends Tony Stark's funeral a week later; Fury is also among the funeral attendees.
